mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (task_no, user_id, template_id, status) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{status})
INSERT INTO task_asset (task_id, asset_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{assetId}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_no, user_id, template_id, status, current_stage, failure_stage, failure_reason, result_url, created_at, updated_at FROM task WHERE task_no = #{taskNo}

SELECT id, task_no, user_id, template_id, status, current_stage, failure_stage, failure_reason, result_url, created_at, updated_at FROM task WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT a.url FROM task_asset ta JOIN asset a ON a.id = ta.asset_id WHERE ta.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY ta.sort_order

SELECT a.id, a.asset_no, a.user_id, a.template_id, a.original_name, a.stored_path, a.url, a.mime_type, a.size_bytes FROM task_asset ta JOIN asset a ON a.id = ta.asset_id WHERE ta.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY ta.sort_order
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND user_id = #{userId}
